name: Original Maine Factory Store
old_description: From lifelong Mainers to those who visit every chance they get, these gifts capture what draws us all here
about:
Original Maine Factory Store operates from Portland, Maine, where it was founded in 2017. The venture began as a mission to revive the state's 1901 flag, a design featuring a pine tree and North Star that flew over Maine from 1901 to 1909. The founders, inspired by that historic symbol, built a brand around Maine craftsmanship and design.

The company designs and produces a range of Maine-themed goods, including flags, apparel such as t-shirts, hoodies, and hats, and home goods. According to the company, all products are designed in Portland and most are manufactured there, with many items made by local makers and artisans. The operation includes a factory store in Portland and an online shop powered by Shopify. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Original Maine serves retail customers, tourists, and gift buyers looking for authentically Maine products. Its customer base includes lifelong Mainers and visitors who want a piece of the state's independent spirit. The product line spans flags, vintage-style graphic tees, beanies, dad hats, trucker hats, and collaborative items such as the Flowfold x Original Maine collection.

The company distinguishes itself through its commitment to local design and production, tying each item to Maine's heritage. Its affiliation with Maine Flag Company underscores a focus on quality flag manufacturing alongside the broader gift collection. The brand positions itself as a celebration of Maine craftsmanship rather than a generic souvenir maker.
